notes:
Recap Page 4.7.0 is a reading-list and progress companion, not a comic reader. No Recap Page account or sign-in is needed to test lists, Read or Reading options. Comics are not included. Marvel decides what is available to read and whether an account or payment is needed.

Please test with an internet connection:

1. From Home, open Modern Timeline and find House of M: Main Series and Branded Tie-Ins. Preview the list, add it to Library, then open the saved list.
2. Tap Read for House of M (2005) #1. This comic has a link for the Marvel Comics app by WEBTOON. Recap Page opens that link outside Recap Page.
3. Where Reading options appears near Read, tap it to see the other choices. This control appears only when a comic has at least two choices. Before December 7, 2026, choices can include Marvel Unlimited. Some comics also offer links to look for a book on Hoopla or in Libby. These links do not guarantee that your library can lend the book. Choices vary by comic.
4. Return to Recap Page, mark a comic read, then close and reopen the saved list to check that progress remains.

On iPhone and iPad, we have not confirmed whether a Marvel Comics link opens the installed Marvel Comics app. The link may open a website instead. A working website link does not prove that the installed app opens it.

Reading in Marvel Unlimited ends December 7, 2026. Until then, a comic without a Marvel Comics link can open in Marvel Unlimited. From December 7, comics without that link show Find on Marvel Comics and open the general Marvel Comics website, not a single-comic page. Marvel Unlimited is no longer offered under Reading options. This switch follows the device's local date.

No reading-service accounts, subscriptions or paid comics are supplied for review. Signing in to a reading service is separate from using Recap Page. Cloud backup is optional and is not needed for these checks.
